rationale.conceptual: Standard DFT calculations of defect formation energies and hydrogen adsorption free energies using the computational hydrogen electrode model; no novel methods or deep theoretical derivations required.
rationale.execution: Pipeline includes building defect supercells, structural relaxations, formation energy calculations, static H adsorption calculations, and energy post-processing; requires managing multiple DFT runs with proper convergence, but still manageable for an experienced user.

difficulty.reasoning: The task reproduces standard DFT defect formation energies and hydrogen adsorption free energies for co-doped MoS2. Overall difficulty is moderate.
